title: Mins to Broadway | Sleeps 6 | Gym | Pool
description:
Stay in the heart of Nashville with CMC Stays  — a Nashville luxury unit designed for connection, comfort, and unforgettable memories. 

2 miles to Broadway
2 miles to The Parthenon
5 Miles to Titan Stadium

The space
This elegantly designed two-bedroom, two-bath retreat blends elevated comfort with modern charm.

Enjoy a tranquil stay, elevated by exceptional design and top-tier amenities—all complimentary with your booking:

KEY FEATURES
✔ 2 Bedrooms / 2 Bathrooms
✔  Sleeps 6
✔  Fully stocked kitchen
✔  Pool
✔  BBQ
✔  Unlimited Pool & Fooseball Games
️✔  Board Games
️✔  Google TV & Tuvi 
✔  Reserved Parking Spot 
✔  Fireplace in room
️✔ Drip Coffee & Keurig
️✔ Electric Kettle
️✔ Gym 
️✔ Fast WI-FI
️✔ Welcome Snacks & Water
️✔ Fully Stocked Chef’s Kitchen 
️✔ Body wash, Shampoo & Conditioner

The serene primary suite features a king-size bed with premium linens, while the second bedroom offers a chic full-size trundle, sleeping up to three. 

Need more room? A plush pull-out sofa in the living area provides added flexibility—perfect for families, groups, or business travelers.

Guest access
During your stay at our Midtown Nashville vacation rental, enjoy full access to premium building amenities—including a rooftop game and lounge room, a refreshing pool, a fully equipped fitness center, and outdoor grilling stations perfect for cookouts.

To facilitate easy access, our unit includes two reserved parking spots. The total fee is $50 for the stay. If you plan to bring more than two vehicles, additional cars will need to be parked at the nearest garage called Metropolis.

Other things to note
To help locate the key fob and garage card if ever misplaced, an AirTag is securely attached to the key set. This is simply for key recovery purposes—we do not track or monitor guests, and your privacy is fully respected.

Lastly, early check-in and late check-out requests are subject to availability and may incur an additional fee of $50.
